title: Checks for except clauses that catch all exceptions.
summary: This includes except BaseException and except Exception. Overly broad except clauses can lead to unexpected behavior, such as catching KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit exceptions that prevent the user from exiting the program. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-blind-except and made it stable in v0.0.127.

summary: A subclass of OSError, Exception, BaseException.
